cross_axis_rules: Enumerate every boundary for every relevant function, and meaningful reachable state-transition sequences. Do not claim a Cartesian product proves infinite numeric/adversarial states.
Exercise both value directions and order permutations where economic rights or eligibility can differ; use independent invariants/fuzzing for larger domains.
A contained residual active while its enclosing main is outofrange is an invalid-state negative, not an ordinary positive market case.
Record pass/failure/refusal/source-only/historical/not-run/external-blocked/deferred distinctly, with exact test/trace/source identities.
Do not rerun unchanged suites to inflate counts. Changed fixture assumptions invalidate old composed accounting evidence.
Dedicated10/25/100usercapacity benchmark remains userdeferred; basic concurrency/isolation/recovery safety is still required.
No public transactions/service/site changes, key use, oldnode reset or safeguard/economic rights changes.
acceptance: Every callable row and every current project source function is inventoried, including internal-only objects and shared interfaces.
Every operation family has explicit role/lifecycle/market/size/time/input/fault obligations and complete rollback/accounting invariants.
Existing evidence retains exact source and assertion scope; absent evidence remains visibly unqualified.
Confirmed model/backend defects are corrected with baselinefailure and meaningful focused proofs, without weakening limits.
Report finite executed work honestly and retain open workload/real-external gaps; never claim100percent allpossible behavior.
